name: Craftle
description: The daily crafting-recipe guessing game, in the game. Run /craftle for the global daily puzzle or /craftle random for endless practice. Place ingredients in the crafting grid and craft to guess: green = right ingredient in the right cell, orange = in the recipe but elsewhere, grey = not in the recipe. Ten guesses, nine previous attempts on screen for cross-referencing. Based on the web game Minecraftle (minecraftle.zachmanson.com).
